premise: The displayed nonzero offsets are declared small prime constants; zero is included only in triangular mode. No primality or sieve computation is required.
targetDomain: Nonnegative integers in triangular mode, including 0; positive odd represented integers above 3 in double_triangular mode.
scope: Fixed finite offset palettes; indices are unbounded. Omissions do not refute either unrestricted-prime conjecture.
